description: Given several Lucie hosts (by @handle), return the meeting times when ALL of them are free — the intersection of their availability — for a meeting of the given length. Read-only: never books, never exposes anyone's raw calendar (only the shared open slots). Use it to propose a group time. Times are absolute instants; pass viewerTimeZone so they show in the organizer's local zone.

durationMinutes.description: Meeting length in minutes. Must be one every participant offers. Defaults to 30.

from.description: ISO-8601 start of the search window.

handles.description: The participants' booking handles, e.g. ["@alice", "@bob"]. The leading @ is optional.

to.description: ISO-8601 end of the search window.

viewerTimeZone.description: The organizer's IANA time zone, e.g. "America/New_York". Common times are shown in this zone. Defaults to UTC.

name: find_group_times
title: Find times that work for a group of Lucie hosts
